summary: Fifteen days to Expo (Nov 4); Booth 412 confirmed. Ranking PR #232 awaits Arjun's review, which blocks the scoring API. Sam delivered final screens. Pinecrest wants a live demo before signing. Harbor asked for a reliability plan before Thursday's QBR and reported a timezone bug.

items.text: Smart Slots stays the company-wide focus until Expo on Nov 4. Sync errors are deferred unless sync worsens. The Harbor export limit fix has since been completed.
Nina's ranking PR #232 is up and needs Arjun's review before it can merge and be wired into the scoring API. TW-129 is created with no due date.
Scoring endpoint still passes on test data only. Real recommendations depend on the ranking from TW-116 being merged. Due Oct 28.
Sam delivered the final slot picker screens in Figma, so Leila has them. Slot picker UI is due Oct 29. Sam can now start the Expo demo flow.
Sam needs realistic sample data for the three-screen live demo (book a slot, Smart Slots suggests a better one, dock load evens out). Printed one-pager as backup. Due Oct 30.
Jordan will get an anonymized week of Coastal's bookings from Grace today for the demo data. Coastal has agreed.
Coastal kickoff call is booked for Thursday (Oct 22). Valley is still waiting on data access.
Coastal and Valley need endpoint docs before going live; ticket not started, due Oct 26.
Third design partner still unsigned. Pinecrest wants to see a live demo first. Maya is pushing to sign this week; 3 live partners are needed by launch. Due Oct 30.
Dana asked Maya for a written reliability plan for Harbor before Thursday's QBR. Due Oct 22.
Jordan is building the Harbor QBR deck for Thursday Oct 22. Nina delivered the Q3 usage numbers. Maya spoke with Dana (TW-114 done).
Harbor renewal is due Oct 30. Order form was sent; Dana said it should be routine. The 5,000-row export limit is fixed (TW-102 done).
Harbor ops report Fresno DC appointments show UTC times. API fix TW-130 (Nina, 3h) and schedule-view fix TW-132 (Leila, 4h) logged, both low priority, no due date.
Sync errors were 1.6% on Oct 18, above the 1% target, mostly Ridgeline duplicates (TW-103, not started). Ridgeline renews Nov 20 and is yellow.
Sep 28 postmortem done: the sync worker crashed and nothing retried. Arjun has started the retry queue (TW-104). The error-rate alert (TW-105, Nina) is not started.
Booth meetings: 40 leads on the list. Invites go out Friday. Booth design review with Sam is Wednesday.
Nina is on call this week while also owning the ranking work, the Harbor UTC fix and the sync alert.
Arjun has backend candidate interviews Thursday and Friday.
